TOPIC1.6
Determining Limits
Using Algebraic
Manipulation
SUGGESTEDSKILLS
Implementing
Mathematical Processes
1.C
Identify an appropriate
mathematical rule or procedure
based on the classification of a
given expression.
ILLUSTRATIVEEXAMPLES
§ Factoring and dividing
common factors of rational
functions
§ Multiplying by an
expression involving the
conjugate of a sum or
difference in order to
simplify functions involving
radicals
§ Using alternate forms of
trigonometric functions
LEARNINGOBJECTIVE
LIM-1.E
Determine the limits of
functions using equivalent
expressions for the function
or the squeeze theorem.
ESSENTIALKNOWLEDGE
LIM-1.E.1
It may be necessary or helpful to rearrange
expressions into equivalent forms before
evaluating limits.
ENDURINGUNDERSTANDING
LIM-1
Reasoning with definitions, theorems, and properties can be used to justify claims
about limits.
